children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Thursday, and the yield on benchmark government debt climbed.
was trading 0.2% lower at C$1.3825 to the greenback, or 72.33 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3801 to 1.3835.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) rose 5.6 basis points to 3.904%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt rose to 4.9178%.
futures rose $4 to $100.05 a barrel on Thursday.
